spoken: मीटिंग चार बजे है, नहीं नहीं, पांच बजे है.
expected: Meeting 4 baje hai, nahi nahi, 5 baje hai.

spoken: मतलब मैं कल आएगा, हाँ, अच्छा तो फिर मिलते हैं.
expected: Matlab main kal aayega, haan, accha to phir milte hain.

spoken: मैं meeting के लिए बीस मिनट late हो जाऊंगा
expected: Main meeting ke liye 20 minute late ho jaunga.

note: A trailing English clause must stay English rather than be rewritten into Hinglish.
spoken: मुझे कल morning में doctor के पास जाना है so I'll be offline
expected: Mujhe kal morning mein doctor ke paas jaana hai, so I'll be offline.

spoken: यार वो वो bug बहुत weird है मुझे समझ नहीं आ रहा
expected: Yaar, wo bug bahut weird hai, mujhe samajh nahi aa raha.

spoken: मीटिंग चार बजे है नहीं नहीं पाँच बजे है
expected: Meeting 5 baje hai.

spoken: kya aap thak gaye ho nahi nahi main bilkul theek hoon
expected: Kya aap thak gaye ho? Nahi nahi, main bilkul theek hoon.

spoken: aap samjhe mera matlab
expected: Aap samjhe mera matlab?

spoken: अरे सुनो ज़रा वो report भेज देना
expected: Are suno zara wo report bhej dena.

note: The negation is the word whose loss changes the sentence into its opposite.
spoken: मुझे यह build ठीक नहीं लग रहा
expected: Mujhe yah build theek nahi lag raha.

spoken: क्या तुम आज का PR review कर सकते हो
expected: Kya tum aaj ka PR review kar sakte ho?

spoken: report bhej di kya
expected: Report bhej di kya?

spoken: kaunsa option better hai
expected: Kaunsa option better hai?

spoken: kya hua
expected: Kya hua?

spoken: meeting kab hai
expected: Meeting kab hai?

spoken: tum kal aa rahe ho na
expected: Tum kal aa rahe ho na?

note: A repeated Hindi pronoun starts a fresh clause, so "sorry" here is an apology, not a correction.
spoken: मैं late हूँ sorry मैं अभी आता हूँ
expected: Main late hoon, sorry, main abhi aata hoon.

note: A paused "nahi" before a restated number and its unit takes back the first number.
spoken: teen baje, nahi, chaar baje milte hain
expected: 4 baje milte hain.

note: A paused "nahi" before a word that is not a number is ordinary negation, so nothing is taken back.
spoken: do log nahi, sab log aayenge
expected: Do log nahi, sab log aayenge.

note: The restart replaces the first word and repeats the rest, so the first half is taken back.
spoken: kal ki meeting sorry parso ki meeting cancel hai
expected: Parso ki meeting cancel hai.

note: A doubled apology before a Hindi subject is an apology, not a correction.
spoken: sorry sorry main bhool gaya
expected: Sorry sorry, main bhool gaya.

note: "galat bola" with no restated number is what someone said, not a correction.
spoken: usne mujhe galat bola
expected: Usne mujhe galat bola.
